items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 13:130:1
items.html: Likewise the thirteen Chivaret shine in Zeir Anpin, etc., and it completes for him the thirteen corrections of the Dikna [beard] for Zeir Anpin: Meaning, when we consider from the aspect of the root of Zeir Anpin, which is the discernment of Guf [body], as above, we find that he receives only from the one path that includes them all, which is also the discernment of Guf, as above. However, it is known that although Zeir Anpin is the discernment of Guf to AVI, nevertheless he himself also expands into Rosh [head] and Guf at the time of his Gadlut. And then, certainly, he also receives from the twelve Orchin that go from below upward, for every discernment always receives from the discernment opposite it in the one above; and therefore the discernment of his Rosh necessarily receives from the corrections that go from below upward. Moreover, all twelve Chivaret [bright strands] are included in this path, as above.
